alternatives_considered.reason: Would leave the V47.1 enforcement gap in code.

alternatives_considered.alternative: Allow NA for any row at reviewer discretion
alternatives_considered.reason: Would permit material graph changes without a retrieval rationale.
Keeps zero-change output compact while preserving strict rationale requirements for actual changes.

approval_source: User conversation: after confirming that V47.1 required a code patch, the user instructed “V47.1.1 - generate”.
problem: V47.1 allowed literal NA to pass on non-zero graph deltas and did not deterministically render NA for all-zero graph rows, so the gate could hide a required retrieval rationale or emit unnecessary prose for unchanged graph components.

risks_and_controls.control: Validation rejects NA, N/A, blank, not-applicable, and generic rationale whenever any delta component is non-zero.
risks_and_controls.risk: A non-zero graph change is labeled NA

risks_and_controls.control: The existing integer-vector parser evaluates every slash-delimited component and the new tests cover +0 / +0 and +1 / +1.
The renderer ignores zero-row prose and emits the literal NA deterministically.
Graph, migrations, schema, ontology, relationship vocabulary, and all non-policy cards remain byte-identical to V47.1.

rollback: Restore the V47.1 policy, gate utility, test suite, template, and control-plane records. No graph, migration, or non-policy card rollback is required.
scope: approval, protocol-decision, conformance, QA, release, diff, inline-output, and manifest records
selected_decision: Render the literal NA for every graph-delta row whose scalar or vector delta is entirely zero.
Reject NA, N/A, blank, not-applicable, or generic rationale when any scalar or vector delta component is non-zero.
Apply the rule to both G1 and R1 rendering and validation.
Add five regression tests covering zero scalar, zero vector, non-zero rejection, non-zero vector acceptance, and all-zero-table normalization.
